top_signals.title: No Break on Move Higher in Long End of Yield Curve, Al-Hussainy Says
top_signals.summary: Edward Al-Hussainy, Total Return bond portfolio manager at Columbia Threadneedle, examines the numerous factors he sees impacting the long end of the yield curve. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: 392 stolen vehicles worth $28M stopped before overseas export, RCMP says
top_signals.summary:
